# Story 27 — Solutions & Guides

---

## Prerequisites

- Story 26 (FAQs & Help Articles) provides related Knowledge Base structure and shared publication/visibility concepts. Reuse content-lifecycle patterns (Draft/Published, Customer-facing/Internal-only) if that story has already landed; otherwise mirror the approach here so Story 28 (Knowledge Base Search) can consume a consistent shape.
- Existing authentication/authorization is in place. Roles come from `backend/src/CustomerSupportCrm.Domain/Roles/Role.cs`, permissions from `backend/src/CustomerSupportCrm.Domain/Roles/Permissions.cs`, and are wired via `backend/src/CustomerSupportCrm.Api/Authorization/HasPermissionAttribute.cs` + `PermissionAuthorizationHandler.cs` + `PermissionPolicyProvider.cs`.
- Existing `Category` concept for tickets lives in `backend/src/CustomerSupportCrm.Domain/Tickets/TicketCategory.cs`. Knowledge Base uses its **own** category taxonomy — do **not** reuse `TicketCategory` unless Story 26 has already introduced a shared KB category. If Story 26 landed a `KbCategory` entity, reuse it; otherwise introduce a lightweight KB category on this story.
- Customer identity/portal wiring uses `backend/src/CustomerSupportCrm.Domain/Customers/Customer.cs` and public controllers such as `backend/src/CustomerSupportCrm.Api/LiveChat/PublicLiveChatController.cs` for anonymous/customer surfaces. Match that authorization pattern for the customer-facing endpoints.
- This story does **not** implement search — Story 28 owns that. This story only stores the content and enforces visibility.

---

## Story Goal

Deliver end-to-end CRUD, Draft→Published lifecycle, and visibility enforcement for two new Knowledge Base content types: **Solution** and **Guide**.

User-visible outcomes:

1. Administrator and Manager can create, edit, and publish Solutions and Guides via the admin UI; both types share a Category, publication status (Draft/Published), and visibility/audience (Customer-facing/Internal-only) field.
2. Agent can browse and read **published** Solutions and Guides (both audiences); Agent cannot create/edit/publish.
3. Customer can browse and read **published Customer-facing** Solutions and Guides only; Draft content and Internal-only content are never exposed to Customers, either through list endpoints or by-id endpoints.
4. Published content is stored in a shape that Story 28's search feature can index.

**Not in scope:** search, ranking, recommendation, approval workflow, notifications on publish, ticket linking, AI generation, FAQs/Help Articles (Story 26).

## Product rules (from story)

**Content types**

- `Solution` — fields: **Title**, **Problem** (a.k.a. Problem/Issue), **SolutionBody** (the solution text), **CategoryId**, **Status**, **Visibility**.
- `Guide` — fields: **Title**, **Description** (a.k.a. Description/Introduction), **Steps** (ordered list), **CategoryId**, **Status**, **Visibility**.
- Solutions and Guides are **distinct** content types (separate tables / separate controllers). They must remain distinguishable from FAQs/Help Articles from Story 26.

**Publication lifecycle**

- New Solutions and Guides default to `Status = Draft` on create; the API must not accept `Published` on the create payload.
- Only Administrator and Manager may transition Draft ↔ Published.
- Draft content is invisible to Agent and Customer read endpoints.

**Visibility / audience**

- Two values: `CustomerFacing`, `InternalOnly`.
- Published `CustomerFacing` content is visible to Customer **and** authorized internal users.
- Published `InternalOnly` content is visible to Administrator, Manager, Agent — **never** to Customer.

**Authorization matrix**

| Action | Administrator | Manager | Agent | Customer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Create Solution/Guide | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Edit Solution/Guide | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Publish/Unpublish | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| View Draft | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| View Published Internal-only | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| View Published Customer-facing | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

Enforcement is **server-side**. UI hiding alone is not sufficient.

### 6 — Services + interfaces

Create files:

- `backend/src/CustomerSupportCrm.Api/KnowledgeBase/IKbCategoriesService.cs` + `KbCategoriesService.cs`.

Model after `QuickRepliesService`. Each service exposes:

- `Task<PagedResult<...>> ListForStaffAsync(includeDrafts, visibilityFilter, categoryId, search?, ...)` — for internal admin/agent list endpoints.
- `Task<...> GetByIdForStaffAsync(id, currentUserVisibilityScope)` — returns 404 when caller is not entitled to see it.
- `Task<...> ListPublishedCustomerFacingAsync(categoryId, ...)` — customer path, restricted to `Status = Published AND Visibility = CustomerFacing`.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Customer requests a Draft or Internal-only item by id.** Trigger: `GET /api/public/knowledge-base/solutions/{id}` where target is Draft or Internal-only. Expected: `404 Not Found` (do not leak existence). Enforced in `KbSolutionsService.GetPublishedCustomerFacingByIdAsync` and `KbGuidesService.GetPublishedCustomerFacingByIdAsync`.
- **Agent requests a Draft item.** Trigger: staff `GET /{id}` where caller only has `ViewPublishedInternal`. Expected: `404`. Enforced in the staff service methods by inspecting the effective visibility scope resolved in the controller.
- **Create request sets `Status = Published`.** Trigger: client sends `Published` in body. Expected: server ignores that field entirely (DTO does not carry it) and stores `Draft`. Enforced by the DTO shape in task 5.
- **Publishing an item with an inactive/deleted Category.** Expected: `409 Conflict` with a message telling the caller to pick an active category. Enforced in `PublishAsync`.
- **Guide with zero steps.** Trigger: `Steps` array empty on create/update. Expected: `400 Bad Request`. Enforced by DTO validation in the Guide service.
- **Guide step reordering.** Trigger: update with a reordered array. Expected: server deletes existing steps and re-inserts using array-index as `Order` inside a single transaction; no gaps left behind. Enforced in `KbGuidesService.UpdateAsync`.
- **Category rename affects existing published content.** Expected: renaming a `KbCategory` propagates transparently (only `CategoryId` is stored). Deleting a Category referenced by any Solution or Guide is blocked by `DeleteBehavior.Restrict`.
- **Concurrent publish/unpublish.** Trigger: two admins hit Publish simultaneously. Expected: last-writer-wins on Status; `PublishedAt` updates on transitions from Draft→Published, is cleared on Published→Draft. No exception, no duplicate history.
- **Internal-only content mistakenly linked from a Customer-facing page.** Expected: the customer-facing endpoints filter by `Visibility = CustomerFacing AND Status = Published` unconditionally, so a copy-pasted admin URL from a customer produces `404`.
- **Unicode in Title, Problem, Description, Instructions.** Expected: stored intact (nvarchar). No trimming beyond leading/trailing whitespace.
- **Customer role not modelled in `Role` table.** If Customer isn't a first-class role: authorization for public endpoints must not rely on `[HasPermission]`; it relies on customer identity resolution in the public controller. Do not silently allow anonymous requests unless the intake's customer path is anonymous (verify against `PublicLiveChatController`).

## Migration / Rollback

- Migration name: `AddKnowledgeBaseSolutionsAndGuides`.
- Tables created: `KbCategories` (unless reused from Story 26), `KbSolutions`, `KbGuides`, `KbGuideSteps`.
- Rollback: `dotnet ef database update <previous-migration-name>` reverses the migration; drop is safe because the tables are additive and not referenced by any pre-existing feature.
- Half-applied risk: if the migration applies but the seeder has not yet granted permissions, the API returns 403 to Administrators/Managers for the new endpoints. Re-run `DbSeeder` (which is idempotent per prior stories) to close that gap.
- Data risk: none — this story introduces new tables only and does not alter existing schema.

## Verification Steps

1. **Backend builds:** `dotnet build backend/CustomerSupportCrm.slnx`.
2. **Backend tests:** `dotnet test backend/tests/CustomerSupportCrm.Api.Tests/CustomerSupportCrm.Api.Tests.csproj`.
3. **Apply migration locally:** `dotnet ef database update -p backend/src/CustomerSupportCrm.Infrastructure -s backend/src/CustomerSupportCrm.Api`.
4. **Backend runs:** from `backend/src/CustomerSupportCrm.Api`, `dotnet run`, then hit `POST /api/knowledge-base/solutions` as Admin, verify `Draft` returned; `POST /api/knowledge-base/solutions/{id}/publish`; hit `GET /api/public/knowledge-base/solutions/{id}` and confirm 404 while Internal-only, 200 once Customer-facing + Published.
5. **Frontend builds:** `pnpm --filter frontend build` (or `pnpm build` in `frontend/`).
6. **Frontend tests:** `pnpm --filter frontend test` (or `pnpm test` in `frontend/`).
7. **Frontend runs:** `pnpm --filter frontend dev`; sign in as Admin, create/edit/publish a Solution and a Guide with multiple steps; sign in as Agent, verify no create/edit/publish controls and no Draft rows; sign in as Customer, verify only Published Customer-facing content appears.
8. **Regression:** run existing `QuickReplies`, `TicketCategories`, and `Roles` test suites to confirm no permission-registration collisions.

## Done Criteria

- [ ] Administrator can create, edit, publish, and view Solutions and Guides via API and UI.
- [ ] Manager has the same create/edit/publish/view rights as Administrator.
- [ ] Agent can list and read Published Solutions and Guides (both Customer-facing and Internal-only), and receives 403/no-UI-affordance for create/edit/publish.
- [ ] Customer can list and read only Published Customer-facing Solutions and Guides; Draft and Internal-only are never returned.
- [ ] `Solution` persists Title, Problem, SolutionBody, CategoryId, Status, Visibility.
- [ ] `Guide` persists Title, Description, ordered Steps, CategoryId, Status, Visibility.
- [ ] New Solutions and Guides default to `Draft`; the create endpoint ignores any Status the client sends.
- [ ] Publish/unpublish transitions maintain `PublishedAt` correctly.
- [ ] Server-side authorization enforces the permission matrix; UI hiding is only cosmetic.
- [ ] Migration `AddKnowledgeBaseSolutionsAndGuides` is committed and applies cleanly.
- [ ] `DbSeeder` grants the new permissions to Administrator, Manager, Agent per the matrix.
- [ ] Backend and frontend test suites cover the visibility/lifecycle rules listed in Test Plan.
- [ ] No search implementation is introduced here — Story 28 remains the search owner.
